Confirmed dental technology

CEREC® for selected same-day crown visits

For some crown visits, a CEREC workflow can support digital design and in-office milling. Whether it fits depends on an evaluation of the tooth and the treatment plan.

The patient benefit may be a simpler visit sequence when the case is appropriate. The team will explain what is planned, what alternatives exist, and whether another visit is needed.
